purpose: Separate declared research priority, repository evidence density, theorem proof strength, and literature novelty so none can be silently substituted for another.

evidence_strength_levels.name: PROOF_BEARING_ROUTE_SURFACE
requirements: at least one proof-bearing repository surface relevant to target

evidence_strength_levels.name: PROJECT_LOCAL_THEOREM_ADMITTED
requirements: semantic/reviewer-bound admission or explicit project authority receipt
evidence_strength_levels.promotion_ceiling: theorem valid in stated frozen/project scope

evidence_strength_levels.name: GENERAL_COMPOSITIONAL_THEOREM_ADMITTED
requirements: quantified/general domain rather than one frozen fixture
evidence_strength_levels.promotion_ceiling: general theorem in stated formal domain

evidence_strength_levels.name: EXTERNAL_INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION
requirements: independent external party or implementation reproduces proof from public materials

evidence_strength_levels.name: EXTERNAL_PEER_REVIEWED_OR_FORMALLY_PUBLISHED
requirements: independent scholarly/formal review beyond project authority
publication or equivalent durable external record
evidence_strength_levels.promotion_ceiling: externally reviewed result; novelty still requires separate novelty axis

novelty_axis.name: KNOWN_OR_DIRECT_PRIOR_ART_DERIVATION
novelty_axis.meaning: mathematical content is already explicit or follows directly from controlling prior result/definition

novelty_axis.name: EXACT_STATEMENT_NOT_FOUND_BUT_NOVELTY_NOT_ESTABLISHED
novelty_axis.meaning: searched corpus lacks identical statement; universal absence is not claimed

novelty_axis.name: NOVELTY_CANDIDATE
novelty_axis.meaning: not reducible to checked prior results by current audit and no identical result found in searched primary corpus; still not a universal priority claim

novelty_axis.name: EXTERNAL_NOVELTY_CONFIRMED
novelty_axis.meaning: independent external literature/peer review confirms novelty to a publishable standard

hard_rules: surface_count MUST NOT by itself promote above ES1
literature novelty MUST NOT be inferred from ES level
absence of an identical search hit MUST NOT be represented as proof of universal priority
every potential-priority result SHOULD receive a dated SHA-bound provenance record before further generalization
P_VS_NP remains OPEN unless a dedicated target theorem reaches its own required terminal authority
